statements.t: (NYSE: GEO) (“GEO”, “we” or the “Company”), a leading provider of contracted support services for secure facilities, processing centers, and reentry centers, as well as enhanced in-custody rehabilitation, post-release support, and electronic monitoring programs, reported its financial results for the third quarter 2026 and updated fourth quarter 2026 and full year 2026 financial guidance.
Our better-than-expected performance in 2026 has been driven by the significant revenue growth from the new or expanded contracts that we entered into throughout 2025.

Given the intrinsic value of our assets, including 48,000 owned beds; our strong financial performance in providing diversified secure support services; and our expected future growth, we believe that our stock continues to be significantly undervalued and that share repurchases are therefore a paramount capital allocation priority for our Company,” Zoley added.

We expect the activation of the Big Horn Facility and Rivers Facility to be completed by the end of 2026, with both facilities expected to achieve normalized operations and earnings contribution in early 2027, while the activation of the Big Spring Complex is expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 2027, with normalized operations and earnings contribution expected in the second quarter of 2027.
We expect to continue providing support services under our existing contract with ICE for the Adelanto Complex, which has a full term effective through December 19, 2034.
Today, we updated our financial guidance for the fourth quarter and full year 2026.
For the fourth quarter 2026, we increased our Net Income Attributable to GEO Operations guidance to a range of $591 million to $595.5 million, which includes the gain on sale of the Adelanto Complex.

We increased our fourth quarter 2026 Adjusted Net Income guidance to a range of $46 million to $51 million, or a range of $0.35 to $0.39 per diluted share, on quarterly revenues of $777 million to $827 million.
We increased our fourth quarter 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $149 million to $154 million.

For the full year 2026, we increased Net Income Attributable to GEO Operations guidance to a range of $726.3 million to $730.5 million, which includes the gain on sale of the Adelanto Complex in the fourth quarter of 2026.

We increased full year 2026 Adjusted Net Income guidance to a range of $185 million to $190 million, or a range of $1.40 to $1.44 per diluted share, on annual revenues of $2.975 billion to $3.025 billion and based on an effective tax rate of approximately 28 percent, inclusive of known discrete items.
We increased our full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $568 million to $573 million.
We expect total unreimbursed capital expenditures for the full year 2026 to be between $140 million and $150 million.

Repurchases of GEO’s outstanding common stock will be made in accordance with applicable securities laws and may be made at our senior management’s discretion from time to time in the open market, by block purchase, through privately negotiated transactions, pursuant to a trading plan, or otherwise in compliance with Rule 10b-18 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended.
We have scheduled a conference call and webcast for today at 1:00 PM (Eastern Time) to discuss our third quarter 2026 financial results as well as our outlook.
